plugins.name: spec-build
plugins.description: Builds an approved spec — the suite's back half.

plugins.name: spec-define
plugins.description: Requirements intake for a settled direction — turns a raw idea (or a spec-discover handoff) into one validated specs/<name>/intent.md: probes the repo, grills the open questions until none remain, gates the result, stops.

plugins.name: spec-design
plugins.description: Gated spec authoring for a spec that is not yet approved — an intent.md or spec.md exists.

plugins.name: spec-discover
plugins.description: Five-stage idea discovery and pressure-testing — the pre-spec front door of the suite, for when WHETHER to build it or WHICH version is still open.

plugins.name: spec-release
plugins.description: Cuts a release from work that is already merged and delivered — the suite's release phase.

plugins.name: spec-review
plugins.description: Gated code review for any git repository — a diff, a pull request, a branch, or the whole project.

plugins.name: spec-ship
plugins.description: Takes a delivered spec from its commit to a merged pull request — the suite's integration phase.
